building.habit: Protecting her me time without guilt
building.why: Years of having her rest interrupted by family has made her feel like she does not deserve space. She is actively reclaiming it.
building.method: Setting aside time for vlogs, dramas, earphones — and not explaining herself for it

building.why: She has been the family mediator for years and it is exhausting. She is learning to step back without feeling berdosa.
building.method: Reminding herself that walking away from conflict is not derhaka — it is self-protection

breaking.habit: Apologising when she was not wrong
breaking.why: She was conditioned to keep the peace by giving in. It leaves her feeling resentful and unseen.

breaking.habit: Taking on family conflict she said she would not get involved in
breaking.why: Her parents pull her back in despite promising not to. She wants to stay firm.
triggers: Being the 'calm one' everyone defaults to

decision_making_tools_learning: Two Good Options Rule — reduce any decision to binary (rice or noodles, yes or no)
5-Second Preference Check — first instinct is usually the real one
Good Enough Rule — not every decision needs to be perfect
Delay Before Yes — say 'let me check first' before agreeing to things
Preference Discovery — practise asking 'do I like this? do I want this?'
Decision Templates — for recurring choices like group dinners, use a set checklist
Externalize the Decision — write options down to process logically not emotionally
already_solid: Walking away from romantic situations that do not feel right
Being kind to people even after they hurt her — she chooses not to become cruel
Thinking long-term about money and commitments
Showing up for people she loves even when she is drained
